[[Spawning Power]] | damagetype = [[Fire damage]] | unique = yes | icon = Imperial Scepter }} The [[Imperial Dragon Wand]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] obtained from [[Azume]] in [[Kaineng Center]] after completion of [[The Final Confrontation]] in exchange for a [[Imperial Dragon's Tear]]. ==Stats== : [[Fire Dmg]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) : Fire Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]]) : Fire Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]]) : Fire Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]]) : Fire Dmg: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]]) : [[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%) : [[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%) ==Replica== Except for the [[damage type]], it is possible to create a replica of this wand with the same visual appearance and stats. Replicas will cause the damage type associated with the inherent [[attribute]]. Create a replica with the following: *[[Imperial Scepter]] from collector [[Shen Xi]] *[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Quickening]] *Perfect [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription Except for the visual appearance and damage type, it is possible to create a replica of this wand with the same stats. Replicas will cause the damage type associated with the inherent attribute.
